explanations.d: CPU metrics do not provide API audit history.

questions.name: Detection
questions.objective: Skill 1.3.2: Remediate misconfiguration of resources.
questions.text: A metric filter for unauthorized API calls never matches because the log pattern uses the wrong JSON field. What should be changed?

answers.text: Raise the alarm threshold to a very high value
Delete the source log group
Move the filter to an unrelated application log
Correct the metric filter pattern and test it against representative log events

explanations.a: Changing threshold does not fix a filter that emits no metric data.
explanations.b: Deleting logs removes evidence and prevents matching.
explanations.c: An unrelated log group will not contain the target API events.
explanations.d: Metric filters depend on accurate field names and patterns that match actual log structure.

questions.name: Detection
questions.objective: Skill 1.3.2: Remediate misconfiguration of resources.
questions.text: AWS WAF logs include sensitive headers that should not be stored. What remediation should be configured?

answers.text: Redact the sensitive fields in the AWS WAF logging configuration
Disable WAF entirely
Make the log bucket public so teams can delete sensitive events manually
Store the sensitive header in metric dimensions

explanations.a: WAF logging can redact selected fields so stored logs do not contain unnecessary sensitive values.
explanations.b: Removing WAF eliminates web-layer protection instead of fixing log content.
explanations.c: Public access increases exposure and manual deletion is not a safe control.
explanations.d: Metric dimensions are not appropriate for sensitive header values.

questions.name: Detection
questions.objective: Skill 1.3.2: Remediate misconfiguration of resources.
questions.text: Security Lake ingestion stopped for one source. What should be checked?

answers.text: Only the EC2 instance key pair name
Source enablement, permissions, Region support, delivery errors, and subscriber or data lake configuration
Only the CloudFront origin shield setting
Only CodeDeploy deployment group alarms

explanations.a: Key pair names do not control Security Lake ingestion.
explanations.b: Security Lake ingestion depends on enabled sources, supported Regions, and working delivery permissions.
explanations.c: Origin Shield is unrelated to Security Lake source delivery.
explanations.d: Deployment alarms do not enable a security lake source.

questions.name: Detection
questions.objective: Skill 1.3.2: Remediate misconfiguration of resources.
questions.text: A CloudWatch alarm for GuardDuty findings is too noisy because it pages on every low-severity finding. What remediation is appropriate?

answers.text: Turn off GuardDuty to stop notifications
Page every employee for every finding
Filter or route findings by severity, type, resource criticality, and owner
Delete all low-severity findings automatically with no record

explanations.a: Disabling threat detection creates a blind spot.
explanations.b: Broad paging increases alert fatigue and slows focused response.
explanations.c: Severity-aware routing keeps alerts actionable while preserving visibility for lower-priority findings.
explanations.d: Untracked deletion can hide trends and unresolved risk.

questions.name: Detection
questions.objective: Skill 1.3.2: Remediate misconfiguration of resources.
questions.text: A centralized logging pipeline fails because the destination KMS key policy does not trust the delivery role. What should be remediated?

answers.text: Disable encryption for all future logs without review
Store logs in plaintext on developer laptops
Change only the log group name
Update the KMS key policy and destination policy to allow the approved delivery principal

explanations.a: Removing encryption weakens protection for sensitive log data.
explanations.b: Laptop storage is not controlled centralized logging.
explanations.c: Renaming does not grant KMS decrypt or encrypt permissions.
explanations.d: Encrypted log delivery requires both destination access and KMS authorization for the service or delivery role.
